turn.cards.blitz.zh-CN: 选择一张闪击战牌，或跳过。
turn.cards.blitz.en: Choose a Blitzkrieg card, or skip.

turn.cards.discard.en: Discard down to the hand limit{note}.

turn.cards.total_war.zh-CN: 将『总体战！』加入手牌，或跳过。
turn.cards.total_war.en: Add Total War! to your hand, or skip.

turn.draw.exchange.zh-CN: 弃一张 3+ OPS 牌，换取盟军第24号牌。
turn.draw.exchange.en: Discard a 3+ OPS card to receive Allied card 24.

turn.draw.redraw.zh-CN: 保留一张牌并重抽，或重抽全部手牌。
turn.draw.redraw.en: Keep one card and redraw, or redraw the entire hand.

turn.eliminated_theater.zh-CN: 为 {piece} 选择被消灭战区。

turn.log.attrition_released.en: {piece} returns to the Eliminated Units Box

turn.log.card_added.en: {side} adds {card} to its initial Total War hand.

turn.log.deck_transition.zh-CN: 双方总体战牌、弃牌与未抽取的闪击战牌已分别洗入新牌堆。
turn.log.deck_transition.en: Each side shuffles its Total War cards, discards, and undrawn Blitzkrieg cards into a new deck.

turn.log.eliminated_theater.en: Record {piece} in the {theater} Eliminated Units Box.

turn.log.no_replacement.zh-CN: {side}没有合法补充消费，自动结束补充阶段。
turn.log.no_replacement.en: {side} has no legal replacement expenditure; end the Replacement Phase automatically.

turn.log.place_initial_orders.zh-CN: 第一回合：轴心国放置三个斯大林命令坚守标记。
turn.log.place_initial_orders.en: Turn 1: the Axis places three Stalin Orders Stand Fast markers.

turn.log.mandated_offensive_failed.en: {side} fails its Mandated Offensive: 1 VP penalty.

turn.log.winter_pass.zh-CN: {turn_name}结束：轴心国满足冬季{required}个计分格要求。
turn.log.winter_pass.en: End of {turn_name}: the Axis satisfies the Winter requirement of {required} VP spaces.

turn.log.winter_penalty.zh-CN: {turn_name}结束：轴心国在苏联、埃及和伊拉克仅控制{controlled}个计分格，VP-{penalty}，当前{vp}。
turn.log.winter_penalty.en: End of {turn_name}: the Axis controls only {controlled} VP spaces in the Soviet Union, Egypt, and Iraq; VP -{penalty}, now {vp}.

turn.setup.deploy_armies.zh-CN: 部署德国第1与第7集团军（分处两个占领法国空间）。
turn.setup.deploy_armies.en: Deploy the German 1st and 7th Armies in separate Occupied France spaces.

turn.trench.remove_allied.en: Remove a beachhead or a friendly trench.

turn.voluntary_elimination.zh-CN: 盟军可自愿消灭一个完整补给的英、美或自由法国集团军；可重复选择或结束。
turn.voluntary_elimination.en: The Allies may voluntarily eliminate a fully supplied British, US, or Free French army; choose repeatedly or finish.

turn.victory.allied_german_supply.zh-CN: 盟军控制德国全部轴心补给源，获得自动胜利
turn.victory.allied_german_supply.en: The Allies control every Axis supply source in Germany and win an Automatic Victory
